# Practical Homicide Investigation

> > The definitive resource for homicide investigation techniques, forensic analysis, and criminal behavior assessment led by legendary NYPD detective Vernon J. Geberth.

P.H.I. Investigative Consultants, Inc. provides expert consulting, research materials, and educational content on homicide investigation and forensic psychology. Founded by Vernon J. Geberth, a pioneering homicide detective from the Bronx, the site serves law enforcement professionals, investigators, and criminal justice researchers seeking authoritative guidance on crime scene analysis, equivocal death investigation, and offender profiling.

## Key Topics

- Vernon J. Geberth
- Homicide Investigation
- Crime Scene Analysis
- Investigative Techniques
- Equivocal Death Investigation
- Criminal Behavior
- Forensic Investigation
- Crime Scene Staging
- Criminal Signature
- NYPD
- Forensic Consulting
- Detective Training
- Law Enforcement
- Practical Homicide Investigation (textbook)

- [Research Material](https://www.practicalhomicide.com/Research/research.htm): Research materials on homicide investigation and forensic psychology by Geberth
- [Guide on Homicide Crime Scene Procedures](https://www.practicalhomicide.com/articles/HomCrimeSc.htm): Guide on homicide crime scene procedures and evidence preservation techniques

## Investigative Articles

- [Criminal Signature in Homicide Investigation](https://www.practicalhomicide.com/articles/signature.htm): Article on criminal signature in homicide investigation and offender profiling
- [Staged Crime Scenes](https://www.practicalhomicide.com/articles/staging.htm): Article on staged crime scenes and equivocal death investigation techniques
- [Staged Crime Scenes Analysis](https://www.practicalhomicide.com/Research/staging.htm): Article on staged crime scenes and investigative analysis by Geberth
